units.source_text: 阿民的生活跟丈夫在世的时候没什么两样，依旧承担着所有的农务。

en.t: Amin's life was much the same as when her husband had been alive, and she still took on all the farm work.

units.source_text: 不过，对于招赘丈夫的事情，却不如预想的顺利，主要是阿民对这件事不感兴趣。

en.t: But the matter of taking in a husband by adoption did not go as smoothly as expected, mainly because Amin had no interest in it.

units.source_text: 当然了，阿住只要一有机会，就会不着痕迹的打探阿民的心意，或者直接询问她的想法。

en.t: Of course, whenever Aju had the chance, she would quietly sound out Amin's feelings, or ask her directly what she thought.

units.source_text: 不过，阿民每次都敷衍了事，“了解了，明年再说吧！”

en.t: But each time, Amin brushed it aside, saying, "I understand. Let us talk about it again next year!"

units.source_text: 阿住对这样的回答虽然有些担心，但是内心还有某种安慰。

en.t: Although Aju was somewhat worried by such an answer, she also felt a certain comfort in her heart.

units.source_text: 一方面，阿住也顾忌世间人情，总而言之最后还是依照儿媳妇的意思，明年再说吧。

en.t: For one thing, Aju also cared about what people would think, so in the end she followed her daughter-in-law's wishes and decided to discuss it again next year.
